title: My alarm is too loud
body:
Issue: The volume of my alarm is too loud.

The volume of the alarm can be adjusted, but must be done so in two places.

First, adjust the volume in your iPhone's Settings > Sounds & Haptics > Ringtone and Alerts. This controls the volume of the alarm while your phone is locked.

Second, adjust the volume in the Lasso app itself. Open Lasso's Settings > Volume. This controls the volume after you've responded to the alert on your Lock Screen. Match the volume in both places for a seamless transition.

You may also consider using the gradual wake up feature by opening Lasso's Settings > Wake Up > Gradual. Your alarm will start quiet and slowly increase until it reaches your set volume, giving you a chance to silence it before it gets too loud.
